facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan starts at $25 per month on monthly billing and is recommended for up to 500 contacts.
facts.quote:
Recommended for:   
 up to 500 contacts Starting at $25/ Month

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan starts at $20 per month when billed annually.
EZ Texting's Boost plan starts at $75 per month on monthly billing and is recommended for 500-2,000 contacts.
facts.quote:
Recommended for:   
 500-2,000 contacts Starting at $75/ Month

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Boost plan starts at $60 per month when billed annually.
EZ Texting's Scale plan starts at $125 per month on monthly billing and is recommended for 2,000-50,000 contacts.
facts.quote:
Recommended for:   
 2,000-50,000 contacts Starting at $125/ Month

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Scale plan starts at $100 per month when billed annually.
EZ Texting's Enterprise plan starts at $3,000 per month and is recommended for 50,000+ contacts.
facts.quote:
Recommended for:   
 50,000+ contacts Starting at $3,000/ Month

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch, Boost, and Scale plans each include 500 monthly credits or 6k yearly credits.
facts.quote:
Includes 500 monthly credits

Includes 6k yearly credits

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Enterprise plan includes 200k monthly credits.
EZ Texting's overage credit price is $0.04 per credit on the Launch plan.
EZ Texting's overage credit price is $0.035 per credit on the Boost plan.
EZ Texting's overage credit price is $0.03 per credit on the Scale plan.
EZ Texting's overage credit price is $0.01 per credit on the Enterprise plan.
EZ Texting's Launch plan carries a telecom fee, while the Boost and Scale plans waive it.
EZ Texting states that set-up time is within 1 business day for the Launch, Boost, and Scale plans, and 4 to 12 weeks for the Enterprise plan.
EZ Texting's Enterprise plan set-up time is 4 to 12 weeks.
EZ Texting states that annual plans can save up to 20% compared with monthly plans.
On EZ Texting, each SMS message of up to 160 characters uses 1 credit per recipient.
facts.quote: SMS messages (text only, 160 characters) are 1 credit each

facts.fact: On EZ Texting, each MMS message uses 3 credits per recipient.
facts.quote: MMS messages (including images or video, and/or up to 1600 characters) are 3 credits each.

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch, Boost, and Scale plans each include 1 user.
EZ Texting states that carrier pass-through fees are billed separately based on exact usage, and sales tax may apply where applicable.
facts.quote: Carrier pass through fees are billed separately based on exact usage
